title.heading:
Programming
a Hitec servo
title.text:
Plug in, connect, edit, write.
8 steps on the bench's touch screen.

labels.title: rbmod carrier
labels.text: RP2350 IOmcu board. Its headers J1 and J2 face the case wall.

labels.title: PD mini
labels.text: Adjustable supply for the servo outputs on J2.

labels.title: Display and panel
labels.text: 7 inch touch screen, 1024 x 600, on the ESP32-P4.

labels.title: PROG ports
labels.text: PROGP01 to PROGP04. Fixed 5 V, switched by the bench. Hitec servos are programmed here.

labels.title: J2 · servo outputs
labels.text: PWM01 to PWM04. Not used for programming.

labels.title: Plug in one servo
labels.text: One servo on one position. GND wire at the top, towards the display. Signal wire at the bottom.

pinout.subtitle: Seen from outside the case, display up

say.text: This video shows how the R C bench reads and writes the settings of a Hitec servo, on a bench with the R B mod carrier.
The carrier sits under the display.
Its header J 1 holds the four programming ports. The bench switches their 5 volts.
Step 1. Plug the servo into one position, with the ground wire at the top, towards the display.

steps.title: Open the Hitec programmer
steps.text: On the SERVO hub, tap HITEC.
steps.say: Step 2. On the servo hub, tap Hitec.

steps.title: Choose the port
steps.text: Tap PORT on the READY card.
steps.say: Step 3. Tap port on the ready card.

steps.title: Choose the port
steps.text: Pick the position the servo is plugged into: PROGP01 to PROGP04.
steps.say: Pick the position the servo is plugged into.

steps.title: The series
steps.text: SERIES reads D SERIES or CLASSIC, the HS-5xxx and HS-7xxx servos. A tap changes it.
steps.say: The series row reads D series or classic. This servo is a D 485, a D series servo.

steps.title: Connect
steps.text: The carrier makes the ports' 5V from its 15V input: under 13.5V the bench refuses CONNECT. Hold CONNECT for 2s. The bench switches the ports' 5V on and takes the port out of PWM.
steps.say: The carrier makes the ports' 5 volts from its 15 volt input. With an input under 13.5 volts, the bench refuses connect. Hold connect for two seconds. The bench switches the ports' 5 volts on and takes the port out of P W M.

steps.title: Reading the servo
steps.text: The 21 registers of a D series servo, each with 3 tries. ABORT stops the read.
steps.say: The bench reads the 21 registers of the servo.

steps.title: The servo is read
steps.text: The model is named: D485HW. INA PROG 5V shows the ports' voltage and current.
steps.say: The servo is read and its model is named. The meter on the right shows the voltage and the current of the programming ports.

steps.title: MOTION
steps.text: Tap the MOTION tab.
steps.say: Step 4. The settings are on four tabs. Tap motion.

steps.title: MOTION
steps.text: SPEED, DEAD BAND and SOFT START. The stored value stands in brackets.
steps.say: Motion holds speed, dead band and soft start. The value the servo stores stands in brackets.

steps.title: TRAVEL
steps.text: Tap TRAVEL.
steps.say: Tap travel.

steps.title: TRAVEL
steps.text: NEUTRAL, LEFT END and RIGHT END in counts and degrees, and DIRECTION.
steps.say: Travel holds the neutral and both end points, in counts and in degrees, and the direction.

steps.title: PROTECT
steps.text: Tap PROTECT.
steps.say: Tap protect.

steps.title: PROTECT
steps.text: FAILSAFE, OVERLOAD PROTECTION and SMART SENSOR.
steps.say: Protect holds the failsafe, the overload protection and the smart sensor.

steps.title: INFO
steps.text: Tap INFO.
steps.say: Tap info.

steps.title: INFO
steps.text: The model, the ID, the position and registers with no known setting.
steps.say: Info shows the model, the I D and the horn's position.

steps.title: Back to MOTION
steps.text: Tap MOTION.
steps.say: Step 5. To change a value, go back to motion.

steps.title: Edit SOFT START
steps.text: Tap the value of SOFT START.
steps.say: Tap the value of soft start.

steps.title: Edit SOFT START
steps.text: A list offers 20% to 100%. Tap 60%.
steps.say: A list offers its five values. Tap 60 percent.

steps.title: Marked, not written
steps.text: A * and the accent fill mark a value that differs from the servo's. Nothing has reached the servo.
steps.say: A star and the bright fill mark a value that differs from the servo's. Nothing has reached the servo yet.

steps.title: Edit SPEED
steps.text: Tap the value of SPEED.
steps.say: Tap the value of speed.

steps.title: Edit SPEED
steps.text: The keypad shows the range, 10 to 100%. Tap 5.
steps.say: The keypad shows the range. Tap 5,

steps.title: Edit SPEED
steps.text: Tap 0.

steps.title: Edit SPEED
steps.text: Tap OK.
steps.say: and O K.

steps.title: Two edits
steps.text: Both values carry their *. The footer reads WRITE 2 VALUES.
steps.say: Both values carry their star, and the footer counts two values to write.

steps.title: Back to SERVO
steps.text: Tap the SERVO tab.
steps.say: Step 6. Tap the servo tab.

steps.title: Before the write
steps.text: The note says what the write does: the servo saves, restarts and ignores signals for 1s.
steps.say: The note says what the write does besides the values: the servo saves, restarts, and ignores signals for one second.

steps.title: Hold to write
steps.text: Hold WRITE 2 VALUES for 2s. The button fades from green to amber.
steps.say: Hold write 2 values for two seconds. The button fades from green to amber.

steps.title: The backup file
steps.text: Before the first write of a session, the servo's values as read go into a file on the card.
steps.say: Before the first write of a session, the bench saves the values it read from the servo in a backup file on the card.

steps.title: Writing
steps.text: Do not unplug the servo or the bench while writing.
steps.say: Then it writes. Do not unplug the servo or the bench meanwhile.

steps.title: Written and verified
steps.text: The 21 registers are read back and compared. The tab names the backup file, HITEC001.
steps.say: The bench reads the servo back and compares. Two values are written and verified, and the tab names the backup file.

steps.title: TRAVEL
steps.text: Tap TRAVEL.
steps.say: Step 7. The bench can move the horn to the value being edited. Tap travel.

steps.title: MOVE SERVO
steps.text: Tap OFF on the MOVE SERVO row.
steps.say: Tap the move servo row.

steps.title: Hold to move
steps.text: The bench stays SAFE. Keep hands clear of the horn. Hold HOLD 2s TO MOVE for 2s.
steps.say: The page names the risks. The bench stays safe, so keep hands clear of the horn. Hold for two seconds to move.

steps.title: The horn follows
steps.text: The horn stands at NEUTRAL. A - or + key steps its row by 8 counts, 0.11°, and the horn follows. Tap - on LEFT END.
steps.say: The horn moves to the neutral. A minus or plus key steps its row by 8 counts, and the horn follows that row. Tap minus on left end.

steps.title: Position and current
steps.text: The notes show the horn's POSITION and the ports' current. Nothing is saved in the servo.
steps.say: The notes show the horn's position and the current. Nothing is saved in the servo.

steps.title: FIND STOP
steps.text: FIND STOP searches for the mechanical stop of one side. Tap LEFT END.
steps.say: Find stop searches for the mechanical stop of one side. Tap left end.

steps.title: Searching
steps.text: From NEUTRAL the horn steps outward by 0.5° every 2 passes. A second tap ends the search.
steps.say: From the neutral, the horn steps outward by half a degree at a time.

steps.title: Stop found
steps.text: The horn met a stop at 4840 and moved back 1.0°. LEFT END reads 4915 in the edits.
steps.say: The horn meets a stop and moves back by one degree. The bench sets left end to that position in the edits.

steps.title: Switch it off
steps.text: Tap ON.
steps.say: Tap on to switch move servo off.

steps.title: MOVE SERVO is OFF
steps.text: The servo restarts and is read back: the stored values are unchanged. The end point waits as an edit.
steps.say: The servo restarts and the bench reads it back. The stored values are unchanged, and the end point waits as an edit.

steps.title: Write the end point
steps.text: Tap the SERVO tab.
steps.say: Write it as in step 6. Tap the servo tab,

steps.title: Write the end point
steps.text: Hold WRITE 1 VALUE for 2s.
steps.say: and hold write 1 value for two seconds.

steps.title: Written and verified
steps.text: 1 value written and verified.
steps.say: The end point is in the servo.

steps.title: Leave
steps.text: Tap LEAVE.
steps.say: Step 8. Tap leave.

steps.title: Leave programming
steps.text: Hold HOLD 2s TO LEAVE for 2s. The servo restarts, receives the tester's signal and may move.
steps.say: Hold for two seconds to leave. The servo restarts. It then receives the tester's signal and may move.

steps.title: Done
steps.text: The port is back in tester mode.
steps.say: The port is back in tester mode.

scenes.heading: Hitec servo programmed
scenes.say: The servo holds its new values, and the card holds the values it had before.
